name: Asami Yuuka
source:
She is an trainee nurse who just graduated in nursing from an acclaimed university. She has a cheerful personality and works hard to serve others.

She has big breasts that look tight in her nurse's uniform. She has a peculiar constitution that makes her breast milk come out when she gets aroused.

In search of a clue to cure it, she decided to work at the Sakuragaoka Clinic, which specializes in treatment for this disease.
